identity.title: [v0.92.1][runtime][observatory] Make Polis name and domain config-owned and visible

values.summary: Add the required validated Polis init contract, project it through the Runtime feed, atomically hot-load every Polis parameter without restart, update HTML rendering, and retain focused review evidence.

steps.action: Implement and test the validated Runtime Polis identity configuration contract.
Project the redacted identity through the Observatory feed and production startup/reload path.
Replace HTML deployment constants with feed-owned rendering and focused tests.
Run focused proof and obtain independent exact-head review before publication.

invariants: The advertised Observatory public origin is an exact member of the combined allowed-origin set
REST and WSS default to v2 and explicitly negotiate v1 or v3 without inventing compatibility from constants
Every Polis parameter may hot-load without restarting the Runtime
A reload publishes one complete validated snapshot or no change
Invalid reloads preserve the complete last-known-good snapshot
Identity projection and diagnostics remain redacted
risks: A partial reload exposes mixed old and new Polis values
Runtime and HTML consumers do not converge on the newly loaded snapshot
HTML retains a hidden deployment fallback
stop_conditions: A reload requires Runtime restart or exposes mixed Polis values
Unity or issue #84 paths enter the diff
